description: Machine-readable ChatGPT acceptance report. A report is a claim about a live run; the checker (tools/chatgpt_report_check.py) verifies its internal consistency, never the live system itself.

agent.description: Which agent ran the suite, e.g. ChatGPT-5 + connector name.

anomalies.description: Free-text surprises, even when steps pass. Empty array means none observed.

connector.description: How tools were invoked: native MCP connector, plugin name, or manual curl.

endpoints.description: Exact base URLs tested (proves which deployment was probed).

results.description: Exactly the 16 known step ids, one row each.

detail.description: Observed value or failure text. Required for FAIL; required as reason for SKIP.

id.description: Step id, must be one of the 16 suite steps.

observed.description: The verbatim observed value (number, string, true/false). Never a vibe word alone.

suite.description: Which suite revision was executed (pins live here, so the revision matters).

commit.description: trika-x sha the suite JSON was fetched from, or 'main'.

tally.description: Must add to 16 and match the results rows.

verdict.description: GREEN = all PASS. YELLOW = no FAIL but >=1 SKIP with reasons. RED = >=1 FAIL.

title: svatantrya.chatgpt-acceptance-report/1
